__comment: Chrome/Chromium managed policy — same intent as ../firefox/policies.json (locked device).
Chrome has dropped MV2, so uBlock Origin (cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm) may refuse to load;
uBO Lite (ddkjiahejlhfcafbddmgiahcphecmpfh) does NOT support custom filter-list URLs, so on Chrome
the repo lists can't be pinned. Firefox is the browser this repo is built around.
Hush isn't on the Chrome Web Store; a force-install needs a hosted .crx + update.xml.
Hush's storage.managed also needs a managed_schema in its manifest on Chrome, which it doesn't ship — the Hush defaults below are Firefox-only for now.
